summary_en: Mars Group Holdings will acquire up to 1.2 million shares (6.95% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 4.2 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 30, 2026 to March 31, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On October 29, 2026, Mars Group Holdings' board of directors approved the acquisition of up to 1.2 million shares of its own ordinary stock, representing 6.95% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. The maximum acquisition amount is set at 4.2 billion yen. The shares will be acquired through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from October 30, 2026 to March 31, 2027.

The company states that the acquisition is undertaken to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency, while enabling flexible capital allocation in response to changes in the business environment. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 5.45 million treasury shares against an issued share count of 17.26 million shares excluding treasury stock.
